svg.title: Three apps, one data plane
svg.desc: Employee and admin browsers hit portal :3000 and admin :3001. Both share Postgres. Portal forwards chat to gateway :8088, which calls OpenAI-compatible upstreams.

svg.text: Portal and admin are Next.js; the gateway is a standalone Go process.
